references.text: Here God expresses his frustration with the people of Israel in a similar way to how Jesus expressed his frustration with the unbelieving generation
Isaiah speaks of an unbelieving generation, which mirrors Jesus' words about the unbelieving generation in Mark 9:19
Jesus expresses similar frustration over the unbelieving generation in the Gospel of Matthew
Luke also gives an example of Jesus' frustration with people's unbelief, which parallels Mark 9:19
